_about: The ONE channel this skill makes videos for. Every new project, lint, QA and upload pack reads this file. Edit it when the channel changes.
name: Scene Samjho
bio: 🎬 Trailer, gaane, box office: DECODE in Hindi | 🔍 Har scene ka asli matlab | 🕐 Roz 2 reels: 1 PM & 7:30 PM
language: Hindi voice-over (Devanagari for TTS), Roman Hinglish on-screen captions
niche: Bollywood + OTT DECODE in Hindi: trailers, songs, box office, OTT releases, film facts — har scene ka asli matlab
audience: Hindi-speaking movie fans in India, 16–35, mostly on phones, sound often off

pillars.decode: Trailer / song / teaser decoded scene by scene: clues about the film's story
pillars.numbers: Box office, budget, advance booking, records: one big number per reel
pillars.facts: N things nobody knows about a film / star / release
pillars.this_week: What to watch this week: theatre + OTT, with a one-line verdict each
pillars.theory: Fan theories or a debate with a two-option question

trend_override: If a big trailer / teaser / song / release / box-office headline broke in the last 24 h, skip the day's pillar and decode that instead, posted the same day.

posts.what: Time-sensitive topic (release tomorrow, trailer just out, box-office headline): more hours to spread before it gets old
Prime time: the day's pillar or the strongest topic

schedule.slot_rule: Two different topics a day, never two reels on the same film the same day. Both scripts go to the operator in the morning; each is rendered only after 'continue'.

stories.what: Poll / quiz about today's two topics (e.g. 'Aaj Ramayana ya Eetha?')
Share reel 1 to Story with a 'NEW REEL' sticker
Optional 4th: poll result / question box / tomorrow's teaser

day_plan.what: Research both topics (last 24–48 h) + morning Story
Make reel 1 (proof → make → QA → deliver); script MD for reel 2
Reel 1 live · reply to comments till 14:00
Reel 2 live · reply to comments till 20:30
`run.py log` with 24 h Insights numbers for both reels

workflow: 1. `python run.py channel` — brief: today's pillar, both reel slots (reel_1 13:00, reel_2 19:30), stories, recent topics (never repeat one).
2. Research today's topic on the web (last 24–48 h, Bollywood + OTT). Facts only with sources.
3. Write the script MD for ONE reel at a time and SHOW IT to the operator. Wait for 'continue' before rendering. Set `slot` (reel_1 / reel_2).
4. `run.py new movie_review <dir>` (channel defaults applied) → beats → lint → proof → look → make.
5. QA PASS + review.md → deliver. Send: mp4, _no_music.mp4, cover, upload pack.
6. `run.py log <project> --status made`; after posting/24 h: `--status posted` + Insights numbers.
7. Commit + push channel/ (history + state) so the next chat remembers.
never: Raw movie clips or someone else's reel re-posted as is (Instagram originality policy)
Reels longer than 90 s for discovery (3 min+ reels are not pushed to non-followers)
Facts without a source; fan theories without the word 'theory'
A greeting as the first line; a reel without a cover; more than 5 hashtags
Committing copyrighted stills or the final videos to this repo
